ارتعبت (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَبْتُ (irtaʕabtu) /ir.ta.ʕab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
# اِرْتَعَبْتَ (irtaʕabta) /ir.ta.ʕab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
# اِرْتَعَبْتِ (irtaʕabti) /ir.ta.ʕab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
# اِرْتَعَبَتْ (irtaʕabat) /ir.ta.ʕa.bat/: third-perso
